name: SSL Labs
tagline: Public TLS/SSL server analysis and grading
description: SSL Labs provides a public REST API for analyzing and grading the TLS/SSL configuration of public web servers. Developers can submit hostnames for assessment, poll analysis progress, and retrieve detailed certificate, protocol, cipher, and grade results without API-key authentication under published usage guidelines.

auth.details: No API key required; public free API with mandatory User-Agent identifying the calling tool/application and usage guidelines (no concurrent assessments beyond published limits).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public API; usage governed by rate limits and fair-use guidelines (no paid tier for the public API)

rate_limits: Max 25 assessments in progress; max 1 new assessment per second; max ~400 assessments/hour (check docs for current numbers)
use_cases: check SSL certificate chain and expiry details for a host
list supported protocols and cipher suites for a server
poll assessment status until SSL Labs scan completes
compare TLS grades across multiple hostnames
